source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 988 packages qrcode.mjs as an extra JavaScript module, supplies origin/revision/license metadata, adds license UI entries and excludes the foreign directory from ordinary lint. Current moz.yaml pins revision 86770ec12f0f9abee8728fc9018ab7bd0949f4bc with BSD-2-Clause, and moz.build registers that license family. Those are owned integration contracts. The imported generator algorithm, README, package and SVG geometry are not Thunderbird style evidence. Upstream accessibility, release provenance and the foreign implementation as a whole were not audited.
title: Declare vendored QR integration at the owned boundaries
